title: incubator — namely

translations.translation: 培养的器具, 孵卵器

sentences.sentence: Transport most of us to ancient Rome and we’ll find ourselves in a poorhouse or slave barracks.
sentences.translation: 把我们中的大多数传送到古罗马去，基本只能住救济院或奴隶营房呢。

sentences.sentence: The fact is, if the task were left entirely up to him, we’d be in the poorhouse on just his purchases of mega-jars of pickles.
sentences.translation: 事实是，如果这个任务完全交给他，我们会因为他购买大罐腌菜而住在救济院中。

sentences.sentence: Farming is heavily subsidized (= subsidized a lot ) by the government.
sentences.translation: 农业得到政府的大量补贴。

phrases.translation: 激励频率；励磁频率，激发频率
励磁电压；激励电压；激发电压

sentences.sentence: The amniotic fluid cushioning the baby in your uterus has reached its highest level this week.
sentences.translation: 这周，子宫里起缓冲作用的羊水达到了它最高的水平。

sentences.sentence: Perhaps we are really talking about amniotic fluid, which surrounds the foetus in the birth sac.
sentences.translation: 也许我们真正在谈论的是羊水，也就是包围着胎儿的那些液体。

sentences.sentence: Your baby is practicing swallowing amniotic fluid this week working out her digestive system and absorbing water into her body.
sentences.translation: 婴儿这击会开始练习吞咽羊水，锻炼她的消化系统，吸收水到她体内。

sentences.sentence: The rays are often seen gathering in groups near the surface, “flying” through the water by flapping their pectoral fins and sometimes even leaping porpoise-like into the air.
sentences.translation: 魟鱼经常会成群的聚集在水面以下，通过拍动胸鳍在水中“飞行”，有时候甚至会像海豚一样跃出海面。

sentences.sentence: The Baiji Conservation Aquarium has already scored small successes with a similar breeding scheme aimed at averting the extinction of the endangered Yangtze finless porpoise.
sentences.translation: 为防止这种无鳍海豚的灭绝，白鳍豚保护水族馆采用相同的培育方法已经取得了一些成就。

sentences.sentence: Still, she cautions that it's possible that the Dall's porpoise hunt in Japan may harm subpopulations of that animal, which numbers more than a million worldwide.
sentences.translation: 然而，他警告在日本的捕猎可能危害白腰鼠海豚的亚种的安全，尽管白腰鼠海豚全种在地球上有一百多万只。

sentences.sentence: Factory chimneys spewed fumes out into the sky.
sentences.translation: 工厂的烟囱向空中喷吐浓烟。

sentences.sentence: He emanates tranquility.
sentences.translation: 他身上散发着一种恬静气质。

sentences.sentence: noxious fumes
sentences.translation: 有毒烟雾

sentences.sentence: They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script.
sentences.translation: 你一偏离剧本，他们就会叫停。

sentences.sentence: a shy woman who shunned publicity
sentences.translation: 不爱抛头露面的羞怯女子

sentences.sentence: Victims of the disease found themselves shunned by society.
sentences.translation: 患这种病的人发现，社会上的人都躲着 他们。

sentences.sentence: The bridegroom thanked them all individually.
sentences.translation: 新郎向他们一一道谢。

sentences.sentence: individually wrapped portions of cheese
sentences.translation: 独立包装的一份份干酪

sentences.sentence: An aggregation of fragments is the only kind of whole we now have.
sentences.translation: 这种碎片的集合体是我们现有的唯一完整无缺的方式。

sentences.sentence: Her team is also interested in asking similar questions about human ancestors from East Africa, as well as later species of hominin, such as Homo erectus.
sentences.translation: 她的团队对于回答有关人类祖先来自东非的类似问题也有兴趣，以及原始人类的人种问题，比如原始人类的直立行走。

sentences.sentence: The well-preserved fossils resemble Homo erectus, a species from the genus Homo that first appeared in Africa some two million years ago and quickly spread throughout Europe and much of Asia.
sentences.translation: 这些保存完好的化石类似于直立人，从这个属系的人类来说，最早是在二百万年前出现在非洲的一些地方，并迅速蔓延至整个欧洲和亚洲大部分地区。

sentences.sentence: H. erectus is generally believed to be the direct ancestor of modern humans and also the first hominid to live in caves and tame fire.
sentences.translation: 人们通常认为直立人是现代人的直接祖先，也是第一个生活在洞穴中和学会用火的原始人类。

sentences.sentence: If there is excessive daytime sleepiness and desire to nap, in spite of adequate sleep time, this might suggest a sleep disorder warranting further evaluation.
sentences.translation: 如果白天有很强的睡意，想小睡一会，虽然有充足的睡眠时间，这也许意味着睡眠障碍需要进一步评估。

sentences.sentence: Instead of trying to disidentify from the ego, we need to embrace the ego while merging it with a sense of oneness.
sentences.translation: 不要试图从 自我作出错误的识别，我们需要在把 自我 与“ 单一性 ”的观念相合并的同时，要去包容 自我 。

sentences.sentence: You could also move beyond that and identify yourself with pure oneness or consciousness, devoid of any particular individuality.
sentences.translation: 也可能超越那些，用纯粹的“单一性”或缺乏特殊个性的自觉意识来识别你自己。

sentences.sentence: The remainder must be paid by the end of June.
sentences.translation: 剩余款项必须在6月底之前支付。

phrases.translation: 不活动大陆边缘，被动大陆边缘
被动收入，被动收益；消极收益
无源传感器，被动式传感器

sentences.sentence: Kathy seems to take a very passive role in the relationship.
sentences.translation: 凯茜在这一关系中似乎扮演着十分被动的角色。

sentences.sentence: their passive acceptance of their fate
sentences.translation: 他们对命运的消极接受

sentences.sentence: Your open pores excrete sweat and dirt.
sentences.translation: 你张开的毛孔排出汗液与污垢。

sentences.sentence: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
sentences.translation: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 283 单元

incubator
音标：英 /'ɪŋkjʊbeɪtə/  美 /'ɪŋkjubetɚ/
n. 培养的器具, 孵卵器

poorhouse
音标：英 /'pɔːhaʊs; 'pʊəhaʊs/  美 /'pɔrhaʊs/
n. 救济院
例句：Transport most of us to ancient Rome and we’ll find ourselves in a poorhouse or slave barracks.
把我们中的大多数传送到古罗马去，基本只能住救济院或奴隶营房呢。
例句：The fact is, if the task were left entirely up to him, we’d be in the poorhouse on just his purchases of mega-jars of pickles.
事实是，如果这个任务完全交给他，我们会因为他购买大罐腌菜而住在救济院中。

subsidize
音标：英 /ˈsʌbsɪdaɪz/  美 /'sʌbsə'daɪz/
v. 资助,津贴
例句：Farming is heavily subsidized (= subsidized a lot ) by the government.
农业得到政府的大量补贴。

excitation
音标：英 /,eksaɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɛksaɪ'teʃən/
n. 刺激,兴奋, 激动
短语：excitation system — 激励系统
短语：generator excitation — 发电机励磁
短语：excitation mechanism — 激发机制
短语：harmonic excitation — [信]谐波激励
短语：excitation source — 激励源；励磁电源
短语：excitation energy — 激发能
短语：excitation current — 励磁电流；激磁电流
短语：excitation spectrum — 激发光谱
短语：excitation frequency — 激励频率；励磁频率，激发频率
短语：excitation voltage — 励磁电压；激励电压；激发电压
短语：excitation function — [化]激发函数
短语：excitation state — 激发态
短语：under excitation — 欠激；欠激励状态
短语：excitation threshold — 兴奋阈；激励阈值
短语：excitation generator — 励磁发电机

amniotic
音标：英 /æmnɪ'ɒtɪk/  美 /,æmnɪ'otɪk/
adj. [昆] 羊膜的
短语：amniotic fluid — [动]羊水；羊膜水
短语：amniotic fluid embolism — 羊水栓塞
例句：The amniotic fluid cushioning the baby in your uterus has reached its highest level this week.
这周，子宫里起缓冲作用的羊水达到了它最高的水平。
例句：Perhaps we are really talking about amniotic fluid, which surrounds the foetus in the birth sac.
也许我们真正在谈论的是羊水，也就是包围着胎儿的那些液体。
例句：Your baby is practicing swallowing amniotic fluid this week working out her digestive system and absorbing water into her body.
婴儿这击会开始练习吞咽羊水，锻炼她的消化系统，吸收水到她体内。

porpoise
音标：英 /'pɔːpəs; 'pɒpɒɪs/  美 /'pɔrpəs/
n. [动]海豚, 小鲸
短语：finless porpoise — 江豚，江猪
例句：The rays are often seen gathering in groups near the surface, “flying” through the water by flapping their pectoral fins and sometimes even leaping porpoise-like into the air.
魟鱼经常会成群的聚集在水面以下，通过拍动胸鳍在水中“飞行”，有时候甚至会像海豚一样跃出海面。
例句：The Baiji Conservation Aquarium has already scored small successes with a similar breeding scheme aimed at averting the extinction of the endangered Yangtze finless porpoise.
为防止这种无鳍海豚的灭绝，白鳍豚保护水族馆采用相同的培育方法已经取得了一些成就。
例句：Still, she cautions that it's possible that the Dall's porpoise hunt in Japan may harm subpopulations of that animal, which numbers more than a million worldwide.
然而，他警告在日本的捕猎可能危害白腰鼠海豚的亚种的安全，尽管白腰鼠海豚全种在地球上有一百多万只。

spew
音标：英 /spjuː/  美 /spju/
v. 喷涌,呕吐
例句：Factory chimneys spewed fumes out into the sky.
工厂的烟囱向空中喷吐浓烟。

emanate
音标：英 /'eməneɪt/  美 /ˈɛməˌneɪt/
v. 散发,发出
短语：emanate from — v. 放射；发源于；出自
例句：He emanates tranquility.
他身上散发着一种恬静气质。

noxious
音标：英 /'nɒkʃəs/  美 /'nɑkʃəs/
adj. 有害的
短语：noxious gas — 有害气体
短语：noxious fumes — 有毒炮烟
例句：noxious fumes
有毒烟雾

deviate
音标：英 /'diːvɪeɪt/  美 /'divɪet/
v. 偏离,偏轨
短语：deviate from — 偏离；脱离
例句：They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script.
你一偏离剧本，他们就会叫停。

shun
音标：英 /ʃʌn/  美 /ʃʌn/
v. 避开,避免
例句：a shy woman who shunned publicity
不爱抛头露面的羞怯女子
例句：Victims of the disease found themselves shunned by society.
患这种病的人发现，社会上的人都躲着 他们。

individually
音标：英 /ɪndɪ'vɪdjʊ(ə)lɪ/  美 /ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəli/
adv. 个别地,单独地
例句：The bridegroom thanked them all individually.
新郎向他们一一道谢。
例句：individually wrapped portions of cheese
独立包装的一份份干酪

aggregation
音标：英 /,æɡrɪ'ɡeɪʃən/  美 /,ægrɪ'geʃən/
n. 集合,集合体
短语：platelet aggregation — 血小板聚集
短语：aggregation effect — 聚集效应；团聚效应
短语：aggregation function — 加总函数；集合函数
短语：state of aggregation — 聚集状态；聚集态
例句：An aggregation of fragments is the only kind of whole we now have.
这种碎片的集合体是我们现有的唯一完整无缺的方式。

erectus
adj. [拉丁语]直立的
例句：Her team is also interested in asking similar questions about human ancestors from East Africa, as well as later species of hominin, such as Homo erectus.
她的团队对于回答有关人类祖先来自东非的类似问题也有兴趣，以及原始人类的人种问题，比如原始人类的直立行走。
例句：The well-preserved fossils resemble Homo erectus, a species from the genus Homo that first appeared in Africa some two million years ago and quickly spread throughout Europe and much of Asia.
这些保存完好的化石类似于直立人，从这个属系的人类来说，最早是在二百万年前出现在非洲的一些地方，并迅速蔓延至整个欧洲和亚洲大部分地区。
例句：H. erectus is generally believed to be the direct ancestor of modern humans and also the first hominid to live in caves and tame fire.
人们通常认为直立人是现代人的直接祖先，也是第一个生活在洞穴中和学会用火的原始人类。

sleepiness
音标：英 /'sliːpɪnɪs/  美 /'slipɪnɪs/
n. 想睡,瞌睡
例句：If there is excessive daytime sleepiness and desire to nap, in spite of adequate sleep time, this might suggest a sleep disorder warranting further evaluation.
如果白天有很强的睡意，想小睡一会，虽然有充足的睡眠时间，这也许意味着睡眠障碍需要进一步评估。

oneness
音标：英 /'wʌnnɪs/  美 /'wʌnnəs/
n. 单一,  统一
例句：Instead of trying to disidentify from the ego, we need to embrace the ego while merging it with a sense of oneness.
不要试图从 自我作出错误的识别，我们需要在把 自我 与“ 单一性 ”的观念相合并的同时，要去包容 自我 。
例句：You could also move beyond that and identify yourself with pure oneness or consciousness, devoid of any particular individuality.
也可能超越那些，用纯粹的“单一性”或缺乏特殊个性的自觉意识来识别你自己。

remainder
音标：英 /rɪ'meɪndə/  美 /rɪ'mendɚ/
n. 残余, 剩余物
adj. 剩余的
短语：for the remainder of — 余下的岁月里
短语：remainder theorem — 余式定理
短语：chinese remainder theorem — 孙子剩余定理
短语：remainder term — 余项
例句：The remainder must be paid by the end of June.
剩余款项必须在6月底之前支付。

passive
音标：英 /'pæsɪv/  美 /'pæsɪv/
adj. 被动的,消极的
短语：passive voice — [语]被动态，被动式
短语：passive smoking — 被动吸烟；吸二手烟
短语：passive film — [化]钝化膜
短语：passive safety — 被动安全性
短语：passive filter — 无源滤波器
短语：passive infrared — 被动红外
短语：passive mode — 被动方式
短语：passive sonar — 被动声纳；无源声纳
短语：passive continental margin — 不活动大陆边缘，被动大陆边缘
短语：passive earth pressure — 被动土压力；被动地压
短语：passive management — 被动式管理；消极管理
短语：passive income — 被动收入，被动收益；消极收益
短语：passive state — 被动状态；钝态
短语：passive type — 被动类型
短语：passive sensor — 无源传感器，被动式传感器
短语：passive component — n. 无源元件
短语：passive system — 被动系统
短语：passive device — 被动元件
短语：passive matrix — [光电]无源矩阵；被动阵列
短语：passive element — 无源元件
例句：Kathy seems to take a very passive role in the relationship.
凯茜在这一关系中似乎扮演着十分被动的角色。
例句：their passive acceptance of their fate
他们对命运的消极接受

excrete
音标：英 /ɪk'skriːt; ek-/  美 /ɪk'skrit/
v. 排泄, 分泌
例句：Your open pores excrete sweat and dirt.
你张开的毛孔排出汗液与污垢。

namely
音标：英 /'neɪmlɪ/  美 /'nemli/
adv. 即,也就是
例句：Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。
